_comment: OpenMoto read-only diagnostic addressing profile TEMPLATE for a 2021 BMW R18.
EVERY address below is null ON PURPOSE. No R18 diagnostic CAN ID, request/
response pair, ISO-TP addressing mode, or bitrate has been verified from a
primary source or from the bike (see docs/diag-active.md sections 2-4). The
0x130 traffic captured so far is NOT diagnostic traffic and gives no address.
The CLI REFUSES to run against a profile that still has null required fields
or verified=false. To use it you must (a) obtain the values from a documented
source or measurement, (b) fill them in, (c) record where each came from in
'evidence', and (d) set verified=true. Do not guess. A wrong tx_id can make
the interface the only active node on a segment and get no ACK.
Illustrative note (NOT the R18): many BMW modules use ISO 15765-2 extended
('BMW-FAST') addressing with tester id 0x6F1 and per-ECU response ids around
0x600+addr, first data byte carrying the target/source. Whether the R18 uses
that, normal addressing, functional 0x7DF/0x7E0, or something else is UNKNOWN
here and must be confirmed before anything is transmitted.
